22:t_000:2.en:
$$皇国兵$$
「Are you trying to throw us into confusion and sneak the residents out in the meantime!?」

22:t_000:3.en:
$$皇国兵$$
「Send out the Security Force! The residents of this town will be eliminated as potential insurgents!」

22:t_001:0.en:
$$レジスタンス$$
「The bat bastards have shown up!」

22:t_001:1.en:
$$レジスタンス$$
「What do we do!? Our equipment is no match for mobile weapons!」

22:t_001:2.en:
$$カリーニン$$
「No need to worry. You all focus on guiding the citizens to safety.」

22:t_001:4.en:
$$スズネ$$
「According to Major $$カリーニン$$'s report, the $$新地球皇国$$ is pulling its infantry back and leaving the rest to its mobile weapons.」

22:t_001:5.en:
$n
「Do they intend to slaughter everyone in the town...!?」

22:t_002:0.en:
$$皇国兵$$
「W-what!? Where did that machine come from!?」

22:t_002:1.en:
$$皇国兵$$
「I was told this planet's $$次元力$$ control was at a primitive level...!」

22:t_002:2.en:
$$スズネ$$
「$n...! There are no problems with any of $$ジェニオン$$'s systems.」

22:t_002:3.en:
$n
「Even with no proper resupply, $$ＡＧ$$ is doing a great job too...」

22:t_002:4.en:
$$スズネ$$
「The enemy unmanned units have recognized us as targets and are closing in.」

22:t_002:5.en:
$n
「Please tell Major $$カリーニン$$ to handle the residents' evacuation while we deal with the $$デイモーン$$.」

22:t_002:7.en:
$n
「We have to think about what comes after this...! I'll take them down as quickly as I can!」

22:t_003:1.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Don't let your guard down, $n...! Reinforcements are coming!」

22:t_005:0.en:
$$スズネ$$
「It's a force of Earth-made unmanned units...!」

22:t_005:1.en:
$n
「They've mobilized the garrison units in the area...!」

22:t_005:2.en:
$$スズネ$$
「It's all right. Our side has arrived too.」

22:t_006:1.en:
$n
「As you can see. There's no need to worry.」

22:t_006:2.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「Good work, $l. Rejoin the main force.」

22:t_006:4.en:
$$宗介$$
「Infiltrating the area to throw the enemy into disarray is right up his alley.」

22:t_006:5.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「While $n was drawing the enemy's attention, we were able to get close to the town as well.」

22:t_006:6.en:
$$アムロ$$
「We've also received a report from Major $$カリーニン$$, who was leading the local Resistance, that the residents' evacuation is complete.」

22:t_006:7.en:
$$オズマ$$
「We'll handle the Empire! Resistance forces, guard the residents!」

22:t_006:8.en:
$$レジスタンス$$
「Roger! Thank you for your help!」

22:t_006:9.en:
$$レジスタンス$$
「We're counting on you, $c!」

22:t_006:10.en:
$$レジスタンス$$
「Leave the people of the town to us!」

22:t_008:1.en:
$$ボス$$
「Good work, $n. $$ボロット$$ and I will back you up.」

22:t_008:3.en:
$$ボス$$
「Aw, cut it out. It's all for Miss $$スズネ$$, got it!」

22:t_009:0.en:
$n
「That bastard... Once the fight is over, you just wait.」

22:t_009:1.en:
$$甲児$$
「All the more reason we have to win, $n.」

22:t_009:3.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「So the enemy force is using Earth-made weapons on auto.」

22:t_009:4.en:
$$バナージ$$
「That's the usual $$サイデリアル$$ tactic, isn't it?」

22:t_009:5.en:
$$オットー$$
「All units, don't let your guard down. Seeing our strength, they may send in reinforcements.」

22:t_009:6.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「All units, swiftly destroy the enemy force and leave this area.」

22:t_009:7.en:
$n
(I'll show you, $$サイデリアル$$...! There are plenty of people on this Earth who will never bow to you...!)

22:t_010:0.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「Is that all of them?」

22:t_010:1.en:
$$クルツ$$
「And that's about how it's done!」

22:t_010:2.en:
$$マオ$$
「No time to gloat! Something else is coming!」

22:t_011:4.en:
$$キャシー$$
「That $$サイデリアル$$ ship is sending a transmission to all units.」

22:t_011:5.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「My name is $$ダバラーン・タウ$$. I am the general serving as Supreme Commander $$ストラウス$$'s right hand.」

22:t_012:0.en:
$$アムロ$$
「$$ストラウス$$... The commander of all $$新地球皇国$$ forces.」

22:t_012:1.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「And that's their right hand? A big shot shows up, huh...!」

22:t_012:2.en:
$$クラン$$
「Do they intend to crush us here...!?」

22:t_012:3.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「...$c. I have seen how you fight.」

22:t_012:6.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「But in the end, it is a futile resistance. You cannot defeat us... You cannot defeat Supreme Commander $$ストラウス$$.」

22:t_012:7.en:
$n
「He came all this way just to provoke us.」

22:t_012:8.en:
$$アルト$$
「Then feel our power for yourself, why don't you!」

22:t_012:11.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「General $$ダバラーン$$... It's true that with our present strength, challenging you would mean a pointless death.」

22:t_012:12.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「But remember this. We will defeat you without fail and liberate this planet...!」

22:t_012:13.en:
$$オットー$$
「All units, fall back! Now that we've achieved our objective, there's no reason to linger!」

22:t_013:1.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「I hope you'll at least entertain that person a little.」

22:t_100:0.en:
$n
「Don't think you can win with security machines...!」

22:t_100:1.en:
$n
「I won't let them hurt a single person in this town!」

22:t_101:0.en:
$$カナリア$$
「The Empire abducts citizens... What on earth are they up to...」

22:t_101:1.en:
$$オズマ$$
(Wait for me, $$ランカ$$...! I will find you, no matter what!)

22:t_102:1.en:
$$ルカ$$
「The cross-checking of the data Major $$カリーニン$$ sent over is complete.」

ボロット.evidence: Boss says 'Boss and Borot will back you up'; short form of Boss Borot (ボスボロット, glossary Boss Borot) - Borot is the robot nickname in the Mazinger series

uncertain: 22:t_001:0: コウモリ野郎 'bat bastards' assumed to be the Daimon Police units (bat-like, sent out right after the Security Force order)
22:t_007:0/t_008:0: 操り人形 'puppet' referent unknown (kept literal); the two rows are split halves of one sentence on alternate branches

先生 after Suzune rendered 'Ms. $$スズネ$$' to match dlg_2002_01
